chapter_title: The Pot Maker & Gifts of Grace: Honouring Our Vocations
summary: Unit 2 focuses on indigenous craftsmanship through 'The Pot Maker', a story about a young Naga girl named Sentila who longs to become a potter despite her mother's initial disapproval. The unit celebrates manual artistry, vocational pride, and the intergenerational preservation of community heritage.

hotspots.title: Wedging & Kneading
hotspots.description: Kneading clay removes trapped air pockets, preventing cracking during kiln firing.

hotspots.title: Hand Molding
hotspots.description: Sentila practiced shaping pots in secret using wooden paddles and clay scraps.

hotspots.title: Open Kiln Firing
hotspots.description: Vessels are hardened overnight in open straw and wood hearths.

key_takeaways: Traditional crafts belong to the collective spirit and living memory of a community.
Manual labor carries deep creative dignity and cultural pride.
Parental protectiveness must ultimately honor a child's unique passion.
